badSelector: Unreadable selection: {detail}. Tokens: 12, #12, label:<name>, priority:P1, severity:high, axis:security, triage:<run>, all.
batchNotStarted: Batch {id} of {run} has not been started.
batchReady: Batch {id} ready: branch {branch} from {base}, {n} issue(s). Fixers: {scope}.
batchStarted: Batch {id} of {run} was already started: see `batch status`.
bodyFooter: {who} of {date}{at}. The report carries the reasoning and the triage; the issue carries only the state.
checkGhFailed: GitHub CLI not authenticated: run `gh auth login`
dryRun: Nothing was written. Run again with --apply to carry this out.
dryRunFinish: Nothing was pushed. Run again with --push and/or --pr.
fixerScope_batch: one per batch, one commit per issue
fixerScope_issue: one per issue, one after the other
guardBatchCommand: batch {batch}: command denied by the project config ({source}).
guardBatchWrite: batch {batch}: {target} is denied by the project config ({glob}).
guardBusy: A {mode} is in progress ({run}): finish it, or lift its guard with `guard off`.
guardGithub: {mode} {run}: agents do not write to GitHub — the command does it, after the user agreed.
guardProtected: batch {batch}: no commit on the protected branch {branch}.
guardPush: batch {batch}: pushing is the command's job, once the user has seen the branch.
guardStillArmed: The batch guard is still armed: run `guard off` first.
guardTrailer: The last commit carries a forbidden trailer ({list}): amend it.
guardTriageCommand: triage {run}: the working tree is read-only (/{pattern}/).
guardTriageWrite: triage {run}: writes are limited to the run directory, not {rel}.
linkNotFresh: --link: "{ref}" is not among the findings without an issue.
noSibling: {report} has no {suffix} file next to it: its findings cannot be read.
nothingToPush: No commit on the branch: nothing to push.
openDone: {n} issue(s) created. Running the same call again creates none.
openKnown: {n} already tracked by an issue, {closed} of them closed.
openRead: {findings} finding(s) read from {sources} source(s), {issues} issue(s) in the repository.
openRegressed: {ref} → #{number}, closed on {date}, is back in a later source: incomplete fix or regression
prFooter: Opened by the tracker plugin. Each commit fixes one issue; the issues close when this reaches the default branch.
priority_P0: P0 — immediate: handle before anything else.
selectionCut: {total} issues match, {kept} kept (--max {max}) — left out: {list}. Widen --max or narrow the selection.
selectionCutAtLeast: At least {total} issues match, {kept} kept (--max {max}) — left out: {list}. Widen --max or narrow the selection.
selectionNone: The selection matches no open issue.
selectorEmpty: Name the issues: numbers, label:<name>, priority:P1, severity:high, axis:security, triage:<run> or all.
sinceCommit: commit {commit}, where the finding was measured
sourceNotFound: Source not found: {source} (neither a file, nor a run of {runs}).
statusOpen: {n} open issue(s): {detail} — {tracked} carry a finding key.
syncCloseComment_done: Closed by the tracker: the finding is marked done in {source} (commit `{commit}`, branch `{branch}`, {date}).
syncCloseComment_resolved: Closed by the tracker: the finding is gone from the full scan {source} (commit `{commit}`, branch `{branch}`, {date}).
syncNoSource: No source: neither history in {history} nor findings files in {reports}.
syncReappeared: {ref} is back since the closing on {date}
syncReopenComment: Reopened by the tracker: finding {ref} is reported again by {source} (commit `{commit}`, {date}).
triageCloseComment_fixed: Closed after triage: {reason} (verified at commit `{commit}`, triage {run}, counter-checked).
triageCloseComment_obsolete: Closed as obsolete after triage: {reason} (verified at commit `{commit}`, triage {run}, counter-checked).
triageCost: Cost: {agents} triager agent(s) for {n} issue(s), {unchanged} unchanged issue(s) without an agent, plus one skeptic per issue claimed fixed or obsolete.
triageFinalized: Triage {run} finalized: {n} action(s) proposed. Nothing was written to GitHub.
unchangedReason: {file} has not changed since {since}: the defect is taken to hold as described. Decided by the script, without an agent (--full to have it re-examined).
verdict_plausible: plausible (path not shown end to end)
worktreeExists: {worktree} already exists: remove it (git worktree remove) or finish that batch.
